en: n. one of the parts of the body of a bird, insect or aircraft that it uses to fly; a part of a building that sticks out from the main part; a group within a political party; v. to fly; to hit someone in the arm
ex: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
那隻鳥展開翅膀飛走了。

en: n. a part of something; an amount of food for one person; (old) fate; v. to divide something into parts and share it
ex: The restaurant serves large portions of food.
這家餐廳的份量很大。

en: the quality of being truthful and not cheating or stealing; the fact of being honest
ex: Honesty is the best policy.
誠實為上策。

en: n. a sudden strong feeling of fear that makes you unable to think; a situation in which people rush to do something; v. to feel or make someone feel very frightened; to act in a hurry
ex: Panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm went off.
火警響起時，恐慌在人群中蔓延。

en: n. a thick piece of tree trunk or branch; an official record of events or activities; a ship's record; v. to record facts or events; to cut down trees; to sign in to a computer system
ex: The captain wrote the weather conditions in the ship's log.
船長把天氣狀況寫進航海日誌。

en: n. a continuous low sound like a bee; v. to make a low continuous sound; to sing without opening your mouth; to be full of activity
ex: I could hear the hum of the air conditioner all night.
我整夜都聽得到冷氣機的嗡嗡聲。

en: a. not easily bent; difficult to move; formal and not friendly; strong or severe; (informal) a dead body
ex: My neck is stiff after sleeping in a bad position.
我睡姿不好，脖子很僵硬。

en: unhappy because someone has something that you want; feeling angry because you think someone is trying to take something that belongs to you
ex: She felt jealous when her friend got the promotion.
朋友升遷時，她心裡覺得很嫉妒。

en: a. aged between 13 and 19; relating to people of this age
ex: The teenage girl is learning to drive.
那位十幾歲的女孩正在學開車。

en: a. fixed firmly; fitting closely; (of control or rules) strict; (informal) not generous with money; adv. firmly or closely
ex: These shoes are too tight; I need a bigger size.
這雙鞋太緊了，我需要大一點的尺寸。

en: the act of allowing someone to do something, especially when this is given by someone in authority
ex: You need your parents' permission to join the trip.
你需要得到父母的許可才能參加這次旅行。

en: connected with God or a particular religion; very good and pure; (n.) the sacred things
ex: Jerusalem is a holy city for many religions.
耶路撒冷對許多宗教而言是座聖城。

en: n. a piece of equipment with steps for climbing up and down; a way of progress; a line of broken threads in stockings; v. to get a run in your stocking
ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
他爬上梯子去修屋頂。

en: n. a large open container fixed to a wall in a kitchen or bathroom, with a pipe to carry water away; v. to go down below the surface of water; to go down to a lower level; to become weaker
ex: She washed the dishes in the kitchen sink.
她在廚房的水槽裡洗碗。

en: n. a small figure moved by strings or by the hand; a person or country controlled by another
ex: The children laughed at the puppet show.
孩子們看著木偶劇哈哈大笑。

en: n. a store that sells food and small things for the house; (groceries) the food and other goods you buy from this kind of store
ex: I need to stop at the grocery store on my way home.
我回家路上得去一趟雜貨店。

en: n. a fungus with a short stem and a round top that is often eaten; a thing shaped like a mushroom; v. to grow or increase very quickly; to gather mushrooms
ex: She sliced some mushrooms and added them to the soup.
她切了一些蘑菇加進湯裡。

en: a. very cold; covered with ice; (of a look or voice) unfriendly or cold; (of a road) covered in ice and slippery
ex: The icy wind made my hands numb.
刺骨的寒風讓我的手都凍僵了。

en: the crime of stealing money or property from a person or place, especially using force or threats
ex: The police are investigating a bank robbery in the downtown area.
警方正在調查市中心的一起銀行搶案。

en: n. great fame, praise or honor for achieving something; great beauty; v. to be very proud of or happy about something
ex: The team returned home covered in glory after winning the cup.
球隊奪得獎盃後榮耀返國。

en: n. waste paper and other small things left lying around in a public place; a group of baby animals born at one time; a covered chair carried by people; v. to leave things lying around in a messy way; to give birth to young
ex: The park was full of litter after the festival.
慶典結束後，公園裡滿是垃圾。

en: n. very small pieces of dry earth or dirt that make surfaces dirty; v. to remove dust from something; to cover something lightly with a powder
ex: There was a thick layer of dust on the old piano.
那架舊鋼琴上積了一層厚厚的灰塵。

en: n. money paid regularly to someone who works in a job, usually every month; v. to pay someone a salary
ex: He earns a good salary at the bank.
他在銀行領有不錯的薪水。

en: adv. at a time that is not known or not decided; a. (formal) having been something in the past; occasional
ex: Let's get together for lunch sometime next week.
下週找個時間一起吃午餐吧。

en: n. a feeling of sadness for someone who is in a bad situation; something to be sad about; v. to feel sorry for someone
ex: It's a pity that you can't join us for dinner.
你不能跟我們一起吃晚餐真可惜。

en: something strange or not known that people cannot explain; a story about a crime that is solved; a quality of being strange and unknown
ex: The disappearance of the ship remains a mystery.
那艘船的失蹤至今仍是個謎。

en: n. a large round container for liquids such as wine or oil, with a flat top and bottom; the tube of a gun; v. to put something in a barrel; to move very fast
ex: The wine is stored in oak barrels for several years.
這款酒會在橡木桶裡存放數年。
ph: scrape the bottom of the barrel

en: a gray Australian animal like a small bear that lives in trees and feeds on eucalyptus leaves
ex: A koala spends most of its day sleeping in a tree.
無尾熊一天大部分時間都在樹上睡覺。

en: a. firmly fixed and not likely to change or fall; (of a person) calm and sensible; n. a building where horses are kept; v. to put a horse in a stable
ex: The patient's condition is now stable.
病人的狀況目前已穩定。
ph: lock the stable door after the horse has bolted

en: n. the title of a newspaper article, printed in large letters; (the headlines) the main news stories; v. to be the main person or event in a show; to give a headline to an article
ex: The scandal was the main headline in every newspaper.
那樁醜聞是每份報紙的頭條新聞。

en: a. better or higher in quality, rank or amount; thinking that you are better than other people; n. a person of higher rank or position
ex: This brand is far superior to the others in quality.
這個品牌的品質遠勝其他牌子。

en: n. a hard stone that is often polished and used in buildings and statues; a small glass ball used in children's games; a. made of marble; cold and hard
ex: The floor of the hotel lobby is made of white marble.
飯店大廳的地板是白色大理石製成的。

en: a deep valley with steep sides, usually with a river flowing through it
ex: We hiked to the bottom of the Grand Canyon.
我們健行到大峽谷的谷底。

en: an intelligent sea mammal with a long nose that lives in groups and is often seen jumping out of the water
ex: Several dolphins were swimming alongside the boat.
幾隻海豚在船邊游著。

en: n. the upper front part of the body; one of the two soft parts on a woman's chest that produce milk; the front of a bird; the feelings of a person; v. to face or reach something
ex: She held the baby close to her breast.
她把嬰兒緊緊抱在胸前。
ph: make a clean breast of it

en: a. feeling that you are about to fall because everything seems to be spinning; feeling confused or unable to think clearly because of excitement; v. to make someone feel dizzy
ex: I felt dizzy and had to sit down.
我覺得頭暈，只好坐下來。

en: a. relating to the practical use of machines or scientific methods; relating to a particular subject; according to the exact meaning of the law or rules
ex: The company is looking for someone with technical skills.
公司正在尋找具備技術能力的人。

en: a. very strong or powerful; very large or impressive; adv. (informal) very; n. powerful people
ex: The mighty river flowed across the plain.
那條氣勢磅礡的大河流過平原。
ph: the pen is mightier than the sword

en: v. to let out a long deep breath, especially because you are tired, sad or relieved; to make a soft sound like a sigh; n. a long deep breath that shows a feeling
ex: She sighed with relief when the exam was over.
考試結束時，她鬆了一口氣。

en: n. a short piece of thread that is sewn through cloth; a sharp pain in the side of your body; a loop of thread in knitting; v. to sew; to join the edges of a wound with thread
ex: The doctor put five stitches in the cut on his hand.
醫生在他手上的傷口縫了五針。
ph: a stitch in time saves nine
